title: pH = pKa at half-neutralisation
caption: Halfway to the equivalence point, half the ethanoic acid has become ethanoate, so [HA] = [A⁻] and pH = pKa. Reading the pH at half the equivalence volume measures pKa: 4.76.
alt: Weak acid–strong base titration curve with dashed lines from 12.5 cm³ up to the curve and across to pH 4.76.
description: Half of that, 12.5 cm³: the pH reads 4.76.
